name: Excavation Site: Wetlands

entrance.note: Above Whelgar's Excavation. Reported (warcraft.wiki.gg / dungeons.json); verified false. Deathstalker Agent is on a hill outside, not at this cave mouth.

travel.how: Bad speedrun fit. Realistic Horde path is only if the route is already Tarren Mill east into Arathi: Hammerfall for Zaruk, then south across Thandol Span into Alliance Wetlands on foot — there is no Horde flight in Wetlands and Menethil Harbor is Alliance. Do not send Horde via Booty Bay, Dun Morogh, or a Kalimdor boat just for this dungeon.

quests.name: Changing Tastes
quests.notes: XP unknown in QuestieDB and quests.json. Cooking recipe reward (Recipe: Twice-Spiced Raptor Slice). Pickup in Orgrimmar is a cross-continent extra if you are already in Hillsbrad/Arathi for the dungeon. Balanced only in steps-v2. Forever, verified false.

quests.name: Dragonmaw Rumors
quests.notes: Required lead-in for 95682. XP unknown in QuestieDB/quests.json. Deathstalker Agent has no Questie spawn; 51.4, 59.2 is web-only (warcraft.wiki.gg / Mobalytics). Balanced only. Forever, verified false.

quests.name: Open the Maw
quests.notes: XP unknown in QuestieDB/quests.json. Web walkthroughs: 2 Dragonmaw Saboteurs, 4 Dragonmaw Warders, loot Dragonmaw Dispatch. Agent coords web-only. Balanced only. Forever, verified false.

quests.name: Elder Knowledge
quests.notes: Item-start from Titan Relic (item 270866) dropped by Relic Guardian inside the dungeon. XP unknown in QuestieDB. In dungeons.json/README but dropped from steps-v2 (dungeons-mid). Would have been dungeons:forever:excavation-site-wetlands:accept:95664 / turnin:95664. Thunder Bluff trip after Wetlands is a long hearth. Forever, verified false.

quests.name: Earthen Echo
quests.notes: Follow-up to Elder Knowledge. Skywatcher Plateau, northwest Mulgore. XP unknown in QuestieDB. Dropped from steps-v2 with 95664. Forever, verified false.

prep.group: Five-player Forever dungeon. Catalog range 24-29; runAt 27. Fan guides warn the last boss is higher than 24. Unverified in game.
prep.hearth: Tarren Mill or Hammerfall — not Menethil Harbor
warnings: Wetlands is Alliance territory. No Horde flight. Treat the run as optional; 20-40 dungeons-off text says stay on Hillsbrad and Ashenvale.
All five Horde quests are Forever-new and verified false until checked in game.
Do not invent Classic Wetlands quests for this dungeon.
Changing Tastes pickup is Orgrimmar; do not add a silly Org-to-Wetlands-to-Org loop unless the hearth/zeppelin is already planned.
Kill XP inside dungeons is increased; five entries/resets per hour (Forever hotfix).

speedrunReplaceCandidates.why: Only replace if the route is already Tarren Mill toward Arathi for Zaruk. Skull grind, Dangerous!, and the tail of Battle of Hillsbrad are the slow 24-29 work; Wetlands overworld is Alliance and is not a Horde substitute.
Hammerfall is on the path to Zaruk, but Arathi kill quests sit above the 24-29 dungeon band. Do not drag a speedrun into Arathi just for this instance.

sourceConflicts: Official/catalog level range is 24-29 (Blizzard / dungeons.json). Mobalytics lists 24-32; Warcraft Tavern lists the dungeon 26-33. Used 24-29.
dungeons.json has 5 Horde quests. Mobalytics and Warcraft Tavern list 3 Horde (Changing Tastes, Open the Maw, Elder Knowledge) and omit Dragonmaw Rumors / Earthen Echo as separate rows.
steps-v2 has accept/turnin for 95663, 95697, 95682 and the run. 95664 and 98823 were dropped (dungeons-mid); gotos/report.json still names dungeons:forever:excavation-site-wetlands:accept:95664.
Deathstalker Agent: no Questie coordinates (zoneId 11 only). Web 51.4, 59.2 used to fill the gap; flag as unverified.

Forever XP: QuestieDB and quests.json have no xp field (set 0). warcraft.wiki.gg reports 550/6950/1400/6950 for 95663/95682/95664/98823 and 6950 for 95697; warcraftmaps.com reports 250 for 95663. Not copied into xp.
notes: Forever-only dungeon. Horde access is a long EK trek through Hillsbrad and Arathi into Alliance Wetlands — a bad speedrun fit. Pickup: Zaruk in Hammerfall, Agent outside the instance, Borstan in Orgrimmar if you want the cooking quest. Item relic chain is Thunder Bluff / Mulgore after the run and is not on the current step pack. Quest 79953 and 81951 are not used.
